# GlowTour.js

> GlowTour.js is an open-source, MIT-licensed product tour library for JavaScript and TypeScript.
> It builds onboarding tours, guided tours and feature highlights with one core workflow engine and
> native adapters for React, Vue, Angular, Solid and vanilla JavaScript. Tours are accessible
> (dialog semantics, keyboard support, focus restoration, tested with VoiceOver and NVDA), server
> rendering is verified in Next.js, Nuxt, SolidStart and Angular SSR, and packages ship as ESM only.

Packages: `@glowhop/core-tour` (framework-agnostic engine, no presentation), plus
`@glowhop/react-tour`, `@glowhop/vue-tour`, `@glowhop/solid-tour`, `@glowhop/angular-tour`,
`@glowhop/vanilla-tour`, and `@glowhop/styles-tour` (default theme). All are published on npm,
e.g. https://www.npmjs.com/package/@glowhop/core-tour. Source and issues:
https://github.com/Glowhop/GlowTour.js

Supported versions: React 18 and 19, Vue 3.3+, Angular 18+, Solid 1.8+. License: MIT, free for
commercial use. The full documentation as a single file: https://glowtour.dev/llms-full.txt

## Docs

- [Overview](https://glowtour.dev/docs/): What GlowTour.js is and where to start.
- [Getting started](https://glowtour.dev/docs/getting-started/): Install GlowTour.js and build your first product tour or onboarding tour.
- [Compatibility](https://glowtour.dev/docs/compatibility/): Framework versions and SSR support verified for each adapter.

## Framework pages

- [React product tour library](https://glowtour.dev/react/): React 18/19 and Next.js.
- [Vue product tour library](https://glowtour.dev/vue/): Vue 3 and Nuxt.
- [Angular product tour library](https://glowtour.dev/angular/): Angular 18+ standalone components and Angular SSR.
- [Solid product tour library](https://glowtour.dev/solid/): Solid and SolidStart.
- [JavaScript product tour library](https://glowtour.dev/vanilla/): Vanilla JavaScript with native custom elements.

## Comparisons

- [Best open-source product tour libraries](https://glowtour.dev/compare/): GlowTour.js, Intro.js, Driver.js, Shepherd.js and React Joyride in one table, on framework support, SSR, customization, accessibility and licensing, plus framework-specific options (vue-tour, v-onboarding, ngx-joyride, ngx-ui-tour, Reactour).
- [GlowTour.js vs Intro.js](https://glowtour.dev/glowtour-vs-intro-js/): MIT vs AGPL-3.0/commercial, native framework adapters, SSR and accessibility.
- [GlowTour.js vs Driver.js](https://glowtour.dev/glowtour-vs-driver-js/): Framework integrations, UI customization, builder API, accessibility and licensing.
- [GlowTour.js vs Shepherd.js](https://glowtour.dev/glowtour-vs-shepherd-js/): Framework integrations, customization model, API ergonomics and licensing (MIT vs AGPL-3.0).
- [GlowTour.js vs React Joyride](https://glowtour.dev/glowtour-vs-react-joyride/): React-only vs framework-agnostic, Vue and Angular support, UI customization.

## Framework guides

- [React](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/react/): How to build a product tour in React.
- [Vue](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/vue/): How to build a product tour in Vue 3.
- [Angular](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/angular/): How to build a product tour in Angular.
- [Solid](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/solid/): How to build a product tour in Solid.
- [Vanilla JS](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/vanilla/): How to build a product tour in vanilla JavaScript.

## Guides

- [Theming](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/theming/): CSS custom properties, light and dark themes.
- [Accessibility](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/accessibility/): ARIA semantics, keyboard shortcuts, focus behavior and screen reader testing.
- [Positioning](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/positioning/): Popover and pointer placement and collision handling.
- [Programmatic control](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/programmatic-control/): State subscriptions, step actions and callbacks.
- [Resuming a tour](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/resuming/): Start on a given step after a reload or a later session.
- [Monitoring](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/monitoring/): Product tour analytics through one onEvent callback.
- [Handling errors](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/handling-errors/): Missing targets and failure channels.
- [JSON config](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/json-config/): Build tours from a plain, JSON-serializable object instead of the JS builder.
- [SSR](https://glowtour.dev/docs/guides/ssr/): Next.js, Nuxt, SolidStart and Angular SSR.
